caption: The drawing depicts a detailed representation of an ornate spoon, shown primarily in pencil or graphite tones on a plain, off-white background. The main section features two views: the top view displays the entire spoon, with a decorative handle that has an intricate pattern and what appears to be floral motifs, transitioning into a broad, shell-like bowl with defined, scalloped edges. Beneath this, a side elevation shows the curvature of the spoon with the bowl rising in a shallow arc from the handle, revealing the three-dimensional shape. Below the main window, two inset line drawings provide additional information. On the left, a close-up view labeled "Design on Reverse Side of Handle Elevation View Actual Size" shows details of the handle’s reverse side patterning. On the right, an outline labeled "Contour of Bowl Top Elevation 1/2 Scale" presents the spoon’s bowl shape as viewed from above, drawn as a solid contour line. The background is plain, with the artist’s name, Francis Law Durand, written in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Sugar Spoon
